# pulse_team (Resource)

Manages one organization-scoped Pulse team without managing users or membership. Deletion is rejected while the team is referenced.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Organization-unique team name.
- `settings_priority` (Number) Priority used when resolving team-scoped settings.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Pulse team UUID.
- `revision` (Number) Configuration revision used for optimistic concurrency.
